items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 36:1
items.html: Because there is no imaginary place here to say that it ascends from place to place; rather, the matter of ascent means the equivalence of form. Therefore, when you say that Beriah ascended to Atzilut, it is necessary that it equaled its form with Atzilut and became exactly like Atzilut. (Item 60, and in the Ohr Pnimi at the subheading "Beriah").
